required.bound: boolean: the identity root is sealed under a seven-word phrase
required.refresh_due: boolean: a phrase refresh is owed, independently of bound

reply.source: exactly the three keys of the aumlok object in the pinned organs reply; any other key or type refuses. The face also accepts the containing organs.reply body with its seven frozen sibling keys
reply.owner_origin: read only from the sibling of aumlok in organs.reply: 1..2048 UTF-8 bytes. Shown only in https (or loopback http) origin form; otherwise only this line is hidden

screen.layout: one anchor card (word zero, six letters) above six tiles in the bands ROOT, UNITE and RISE; the state changes only what fills them
screen.bound: tiles filled with dots; the words are never shown
screen.unavailable: an unavailable badge and no bound claim; a failed read removes the last good status

panes: Passkey and Phrase open from the shell's own buttons; this face has no method to open them and no input that takes a word
phrase_strength: 41.5 bits minimum, 43.1 average, the shipped lists; never more
